prompt: A bright morning beach scene bathed in warm golden sunlight shining from behind the camera, casting long soft shadows across wet sand. Two young children laugh and splash joyfully in gentle rolling waves, water droplets catching the light. Wide establishing shot slowly dollies forward, smooth and continuous, capturing the sparkling ocean surface, pale blue sky, and carefree movement of the children as waves wash rhythmically around their feet.
